item.title: Website Design and Develop
item.description: Project Overview Role: Designer & Developer Built With: Figma (Prototyping) Visual Studio Code HTML & CSS (Programming) Showcase: Your browser does not support the video tag. Project Description A Seamless and Engaging Experience I contributed to designing and optimizing the SFU Climate Community website, ensuring a smooth, visually cohesive, and user-friendly experience across both desktop and mobile platforms. The homepage introduces the community’s mission and provides an intuitive browsing flow, making it easy for users to explore content efficiently.
